title: Thug Cleave vs RMD
summary: Do not name a kill target before the gates. This comp kills anyone who is caught — naming one throws that away.

sections.title: The strength is that it can kill anyone
sections.body: Counts are close: Rogue 6, Druid 5, Mage 4. Close enough that no one of them is the answer. Trap plus Garrote plus Cheap Shot reaches whichever of them is caught out of position, and committing to a target in advance is how you lose the thing that makes the comp good. Pick on the global, from who is reachable — not at the gates.

steps.note: Whoever is closest. Free, and it buys the setup.
25s. Land it on a second target, not the sapped one.
6s cooldown silence. It picks the target for you.

sections.title: The go — whoever ate the trap

steps.note: 120s. The slowest term you hold; align everything to it.
60s. Half-cadence, so it is in every go.
The window. Not the opener — Cheap Shot was.
150s immunity. Resets the go; it does not shorten it.
30s. Up every go, not worth forcing.
Free, and your Priest holds no kick and no escape.
120s. Expect it on the Priest during your go, not theirs.
No cooldown. The reason your Priest should not be in line of sight.
